description: energyr is an R package that bundles data published by the US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) from 1996 to 2014, with functions to access and analyse them. It is maintained by Paul Govan on GitHub and Zenodo, with version 0.4 released in April 2026 updating all data sets, input validation and documentation. The data cover electric company finances, natural gas company finances, oil company finances, hydropower plants, LNG plants, natural gas pipeline projects and natural gas storage fields. A companion web app, eAnalytics, lets users explore the data in a browser. Coverage is the United States. The package installs from CRAN or GitHub and is accessible at no cost under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the data end in 2014 and are FERC summaries, not asset-level network data. Simulation uses are historical analysis of gas pipeline and storage expansion, LNG and hydropower facilities, and utility finance trends. Related records: data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker covers current gas pipelines and LNG terminals.
